tools.name: search_usecases
tools.description: Search curated AI use cases using the default hybrid ranking. Use this when an agent has a natural-language search term.

tools.name: hybrid_search_usecases
tools.description: Search AI use cases with hybrid full-text and vector ranking. Supports provider, industry, geography, technology, customer, partner, and boolean case-type filters.

tools.name: vector_search_usecases
tools.description: Semantic vector search for AI use cases using the meaning of the query text.

tools.name: get_usecase_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed information for a single AI use case by RowKey/id.
